A claymore is a melee weapon that can be found within various missions. Its unique variants are the broadsword, the heartstealer, the great axeblade, and the frost slayer. It is the only item in the game to have 4 unique variations.

Obtaining

Missions

  • Obsidian Pinnacle
  • ???
  • Gauntlet of Gales
  • Gale Sanctum (DLC)
  • Tower

Merchants

  • Village Merchant
  • Gift Wrapper
  • Mystery Merchant
  • Luxury Merchant
  • Piglin Merchant

Ancients

  • First Enchanter
  • Unbreakable One

Usage

Claymores possess high power, low speed, and moderate range, and has a combo consisting of a slash, thrust, and a slam. The slash deals the weapon's minimum melee damage, the thrust does about 20% more damage, and the slam does the weapon's maximum melee damage.

Properties

  • X melee damage
  • Powerful pushback
